A.title: What Remains of the Stair
A.text: A stair of metal, bent like a hair pin. Immortals once climbed it to a gate; the gate is gone. A rhyme: step on the bolts, never the plates; the plates give.

Y.title: Hall of Winds, Plainly
Y.text: The wind here never stops; it pushes toward the edge. Lean into it and keep your back to a wall. A strong gust takes a person off the terrace; the Lodge lost a man that way.

R.title: Breath of the Cloud Court
R.text: They did not eat much, the immortals; they breathed. In through the nose to the count of eight, out in twelve. That is how the palace was held up; do it here and the fall slows.

G.title: Pill Pavilion Inventory
G.text: Jars labeled with a single character; most are empty. A few hold dust that was once a pill. Immortals took them to live forever; they stopped when the jars ran dry.

M.title: The Fallen Throne
M.text: A throne sits at the bottom with no one in it. The legs are cut cleanly; this was not an earthquake. Someone wanted the immortal to come down, and he did.

O.title: Crane Terrace Marker
O.text: Cranes were kept here, white ones, for riding. They are gone but their nests are not; check each nest. Some hold a feather the length of your arm; worth the climb.

U.title: Edict of Heaven, Torn
U.text: The edict reads: LET NO ONE ASCEND WITHOUT BALANCE; the rest is burned. Somebody wanted to ascend without it, and tore the edict to make a point. The terraces fell soon after.

X.title: A Scholar's Last Page
X.text: I came to read the old words. I stayed to read the wind; the jade has them in its veins if you hold it to the light. There is a lot about the Accord; mostly about how little of it was kept.
